question: Does forcing all four sides to come from one coordinate action discard useful cross-view localization evidence?
motivation: Whole-box image/DFL refinements failed; test a different action space. A crop can contain good evidence for one side and worse evidence for another. No new image representation or continuation of stopped pixel/DFL training.
sample: Exactly candidate18 frozen128 fitting/64 head-held-out train images, original six-action menus and same-owned GT references.
budget: Cached geometry only, zero image decoding, detector forward or detector training. Two32-hidden-unit residual heads, four outputs per action,8epochs/batch512/AdamW lr0.0002 weight_decay0.0001. Seed0 first;1/2 only after seed0 passes.
inputs: Unchanged68 historical train-normalized geometry features per action. Frozen uniform scalar utility broadcasts to four sides. Residual heads share initial weights and zero output layer, so initial whole/side selectors exactly reproduce uniform.
labels: For owned rows compute absolute left/top/right/bottom coordinate error against the SAME original owned GT, normalized by original calibrated anchor width/height. No new GT ownership per action/side. Unowned rows prefer the frozen uniform slot on every side. Active rows score>=0.05, >=2 valid slots.

objectives.side_gain: SmoothL1 beta0.1 to frozen_uniform_reference_utility + normalized_error(uniform)-normalized_error(action), averaged over valid owned actions/sides; common unowned keep loss
objectives.side_rank: Per-side valid unordered action pairs whose normalized absolute-error difference exceeds0.01, softplus signed utility difference temperature0.05; common unowned keep loss

readouts.gain_whole: Mean four side utilities, original select_actions selects one whole box
readouts.gain_composed: Independently apply unchanged select_actions rule to each side of SAME gain head, compose four coordinates
readouts.rank_whole: Mean four side utilities, original selector chooses one whole box
readouts.rank_composed: Independently select four coordinates from SAME rank head

validity: If composed width/height<=0 or nonfinite, revert the entire row to frozen uniform. Scores, class, count and order always preserved. Report true new compositions not identical to any original valid whole action.
evaluation: Full one-to-one matching at confidence0.25 over IoU0.50:0.05:0.95, tiny/small_all mean recall, plus FPPI0.5. Controls frozen uniform/regret, same-head whole readout, side_gain composed. This is not official AP/AR.
pass_action: Only allows separately registered official and fresh-scene feasibility audit. Side-wise localization is established by SABL/BorderDet; independent side selection and cross-view fusion also require nearest-prior comparison before any novelty claim.
fail_action: Stop this fixed geometry-only side-composition recipe. Do not change error margin, objectives, normalization, epochs, side selector, validity fallback or seeds to rescue it.
limits: Small repeatedly viewed training-scene split, uniform diagnostic ignore filtering inherited, side-wise nominal targets remain annotation-sensitive, independent side choices may form unsupported combinations. A success would be a candidate action-space result, not automatically a new method.
